visual_requirements.description: One bull-shaped manifestation of Rain, one head, two horns, four legs; adult Kua rides on its back fully clothed.
Kua scatters buchu on its forehead; the rain moves with the bull, visibly confined to its advancing body and path, while the pit dries behind it.
The Rain Bull leaving its water pit, with a sharply bounded moving rain curtain around its body.

prompt: ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of the Rain Bull, the living Rain in bull form in San mythology, carrying the adult woman Kua. ANATOMY: exactly one powerful bull body, one head, two horns, two eyes, four bovine legs and one tail; on its back one fully clothed adult woman Kua in plain opaque earth-colored woven wrap covering chest and thighs. [wd-q12279265-c04,c10,c12,c14] MOMENT: the Rain Bull strides diagonally toward the viewer out of a drying water pit, Kua leaning forward on its back and visibly scattering a handful of small green buchu leaves onto the bull's forehead between its horns. [c10,c13,c14,c16] POWER: make the bull unmistakably the Rain itself: the animal emerges from a dense body-hugging storm cloud shaped by its shoulders and back, heavy rain streams physically downward from its mane, flanks and surrounding moving cloud, creating a sharply bounded curtain ONLY along the animal's path; outside that moving curtain the distant earth and sky are clear and dry. Behind its hind feet, the water pit is already drying to cracked mud. No ordinary landscape-wide rain. No lightning or beams. [c02,c04,c12,c16] SCALE & CAMERA: close three-quarter low view, bull fills the square from horns to hooves, rider clearly visible and not tiny; natural bull scale, no giant inflation. LIGHT & WEATHER: one break of warm low sun sharply rim-lights the bull, rider, individual leaves and cascading rain against dark walnut storm shadows. SURFACE: wet coarse dark hide, textured horns and hooves, dull opaque cloth, individual glossy buchu leaves, churned wet mud in front and drying pit behind. SETTING: minimal southern African water pit, travel through the boundary between living rain and dry earth. [c02,c16] MOOD: overwhelming, benevolent, life-giving living Rain, respectful to a living tradition; forceful motion and imposing body, never a placid farm bull. HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, signatures, pseudo-writing, symbols, logo, border, frame, watermark, rectangular patches or collage seams; no extra heads or limbs, no nudity or explicit gore, no neon aura, energy ribbons, magical tattoos, no borrowed film/game/anime/comic design. Original full-image generation, not an edit.

artistic_choices: The body-hugging cloud and bounded rain curtain visualize the documented identity of the bull as Rain and the fact that rain follows his movement, rather than asserting new anatomy or a new power. Clothing, dark hide, camera, palette and the exact placement of leaves and mud are editorial. Natural bull scale; no generic aura, lightning, healing beams, gore or invented iconography.
